scientific_question: Can author-salient contribution anchors from the paper's own front matter and conclusion/future-work context guide Qwen to generate answer-free atomic evidence obligations that recover the high-value teacher atoms missed by one-shot source-aware intent generation?

research_basis.source: Scientific Discourse Tagging for Evidence Extraction
research_basis.lesson: Scientific discourse roles such as fact, goal, method, result, and implication provide useful structure for downstream claim and evidence extraction; evidence selection should model rhetorical function rather than answerability alone.

research_basis.source: Pretrained Language Models for Sequential Sentence Classification
research_basis.lesson: Scientific sentence roles depend on document context, supporting salience modeling at the discourse level rather than isolated proposition classification.

research_basis.source: ARTU / TU Wien and Artificial Researcher @ LongSumm 20
research_basis.lesson: A practical scholarly-document pipeline used abstract sentences as queries into the body and explicitly prioritized Claim/Method and Conclusion/Result rhetorical zones.

research_basis.source: The Nature of NLP: Analyzing Contributions in NLP Papers / NLPContributions
research_basis.lesson: Scientific contribution statements are a distinct extractable target; the released corpus and models identify contribution-bearing statements instead of treating all answerable sentences as equally important.

Contribution sentence detection is meaningfully easier than full contribution-graph construction; use contribution identification as a salience signal, not a requirement to build triples in Wave 7A.3.

Argumentative-zone classification is useful across scientific papers, but domain-specific encoders materially affect performance; therefore do not add a new trained discourse model before testing a model-family-fixed rhetorical/author-anchor architecture.

generator_arms.input_scope: topic + title + exact existing coarse top-12 source regions

obligation_context.input_scope: accepted author anchors + exact existing coarse top-12 source regions

generator_arms.principle: The author anchors establish which scientific claims/problems/results/limitations are salient; selected evidence is used only to formulate concrete atomic questions needed to substantiate those anchors.

deterministic_intents.question: What is the main method, framework, or algorithm proposed or evaluated?
How is the model or method trained, pre-trained, adapted, or otherwise prepared?
How are training examples, pairs, labels, or supervision signals constructed?
What datasets, testbeds, devices, samples, or domains are used?
What acquisition hardware, software, sensing setup, or measurement settings are used?
What baseline methods or comparison systems are used?
What evaluation metrics or success criteria are reported?
What quantitative results, gains, losses, or comparisons are reported?
Under what experimental conditions, scenarios, domains, or splits are results reported?
What robustness, generalization, domain-shift, or failure-case results are reported?
What limitations, weaknesses, or unresolved failure modes do the authors identify?
What future work or follow-up research do the authors propose?

teacher_anti_leak_audit.purpose: Teacher-only post-generation audit. Forbidden teacher answers are never shown to the generator.
teacher_anti_leak_audit.numeric_token_policy: Any retrieval question containing a digit is rejected before retrieval.
teacher_anti_leak_audit.source_copy_policy: Reject a retrieval question if it copies a contiguous >=9-token sequence from either the author-salience context or selected evidence context.
teacher_anti_leak_audit.anchor_policy: Anchors may summarize author-framed claims and may contain source facts because anchors are not themselves retrieval queries; teacher-specific forbidden-answer auditing applies to retrieval questions.

retrieval.candidate_pool: Same exact propositions on pages reached by existing top-12 FACET_INTERLEAVED_BM25_V1 coarse region route.

WAVE7A3_PROMISING: Candidate with BM25 or BGE hybrid supports >=10/13 teacher atoms in fused top-24.
Candidate recovers >=3/6 residual atoms missed by the frozen source-aware BM25 control.
Candidate retains >=6/7 atoms supported by the frozen source-aware BM25 control.
Candidate nine-paper merged page recall >=90% of coarse selected-page recall ceiling.
Candidate improves teacher supported atoms by >=3 over the matching frozen source-aware control.
WAVE7A3_PARTIAL: No candidate pair meets PROMISING, but candidate supports >=8/13 teacher atoms, recovers >=2/6 residual atoms, and improves by >=1 atom over the matching frozen source-aware control.
No hard provenance or anti-leak boundary fails.
WAVE7A3_REJECT: Candidate meets neither PROMISING nor PARTIAL, or a hard provenance/anti-leak boundary fails.

deferred_if_needed: If author-anchored obligations fail under the frozen gate, then evaluate a trained contribution/discourse classifier such as SciBERT-based contribution-statement or argumentative-zone tagging as a new independent variable.
Do not add a new trained salience model in the same experiment; Wave 7A.3 first isolates whether author-framed rhetorical anchoring solves salience with the already-accepted Qwen model.
